title: OotleInvoice
summary: Pay-by-link invoice prototype with exact amounts, expiry and receipt NFTs. The creator publishes an MIT-licensed Rust template and a walletless browser simulation. The November 12 README explicitly states that the browser demo does not connect to a Tari network or process real payments, and the template has not been deployed to testnet or mainnet. This recording walks through the public README, its simulation limits and template API; it does not demonstrate on-chain payments.
cardSummary: Explore pay-by-link invoices, exact payment amounts and receipt checks in a walletless browser simulation.
creator: GenieBuilds

recording.credit: Docs walkthrough — invoice design and simulation limits
